name: io.github.kyanitelabs/achiote
title: Achiote
description: Food-memory reconstruction: recreate childhood dishes with ingredients available where you are.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the model provider that drives reconstruct_food_memory. Optional for the granular deterministic tools; required for the full single-call reconstruction.

environmentVariables.name: ACHIOTE_CACHE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the local research cache database (.db). Holds dish/region research, never raw memories. Defaults to ~/.cache/achiote/culture-cache.db.
